blocks.text: Marketing systems that lower CAC, grow retention, and scale!

I help startups and scale-ups build the marketing engine they need to grow — connecting acquisition, CRM, retention, analytics, and creative execution into one practical system grounded in real customer data.
Hear of CRM

What I Do the Best
I take CRM from "one of the channels" to the dominant revenue engine.
Across CMO-tenures and Head-of-CRM roles, I've built CRM functions from zero, scaled teams up to 18 people, and led transformations where CRM became the primary driver of growth.
What I'm strongest at:
– Building CRM functions from scratch in marketplace and consumer e-commerce contexts
– Designing customer data architectures and behavioral segmentation frameworks
– Leading teams across strategy, lifecycle, analytics, and execution
– Applying A/B testing at scale and decile analysis to find real audience and growth levers
– Bridging data, product, and brand stakeholders to align CRM with business outcomes
Selected Outcomes
A handful of moments that show how I work.
Yandex Eats → Foodtech / Marketplace

Built the CRM function from scratch at one of the two leaders of Russian food delivery. Within one quarter: +5% incremental revenue on a mature product, measured via control group. Team grew from 3 to 18-20 people. Designed a behavioral brand affinity matrix across tens of thousands of brands.
KupiVip → Online Fashion Discounter

Led marketing at one of Russia's largest fashion flash-sales marketplaces during a turnaround year. CRM share of revenue 11% → 74% in 11 months. Drove the first positive EBITDA in company history. Rebuilt audience strategy through decile analysis + deep interviews.
Out of Cloud (CRM Agency) → 30+ Enterprise Clients

Acted as Head of CRM across a portfolio including Vprok.ru (X5), Haier, JBL/Harman, Vita Pharmacies. Built the strategist function from 1 to 10 people in 16 months. Published client outcomes: Vprok CRM share 5% → 10% (+200M RUB), Haier capture rate 0.67% → 1.2%, JBL CPL 2.7x below benchmark.
Confidential E-commerce Marketplace (2025–present) → Fashion / Group-buy

Currently CMO at a regional marketplace with no paid acquisition channel by design. In 8 months: email revenue per delivered message 1.8 → 7 RUB (4x), channel revenue 5x, popup cart buyout rate 12% → 45%. Protected social channels through platform disruption (+1.8x). All with less than 1 FTE on CRM.
Svyaznoy → Mobile Tech Retail, 3,500 Stores

Loyalty function lead for one of the largest Russian retail chains of its era. Transactions per user 1.2 → 4.1. Designed the decile analysis methodology and "Methylene Blue Method" framework I now apply across every retail and digital project.
Education
Skills & Stack

CRM / CDP platforms: Bloomreach Engagement (Exponea), Mindbox, HubSpot, 40+ platforms across foodtech, retail and SaaS. Architectural fluency with all major enterprise CDP-tier products (Salesforce Data Cloud, Segment, Tealium, Adobe Real-Time CDP, Hightouch); willing to onboard to any new platform in 2–4 weeks.
Analytics & BI: Amplitude, Mixpanel, Looker Studio (preferred), Tableau, Power BI, GA4, Metabase.
Methods: behavioral segmentation, lifecycle architecture, A/B testing at scale, decile analysis, brand affinity modeling, multi-attribute product modeling, customer data infrastructure design.
AI / Automation: ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, n8n, Latenode. AI-assisted content factories. Comfortable using AI for analytical work, content generation, and operations.
Leadership: team-building from zero, player-manager operating mode, cross-functional collaboration with product/engineering/data teams.
